zoning_upside.rule: extra units by right (allowed minus existing): 0 -> 0, 3+ -> 30, linear between

profit.rule: build-and-sell return on cost at the 25th percentile of the range: <=0% -> 0, >=25% -> 30, linear between
profit.note: needs a nightly by-right feasibility run for every parcel

requires.rule: no profit points when the lot has no land price or its sale comps came from citywide (ring 4); the screen still shows the math
requires.why: 2026-11-01 full run: 8,368 of 19,792 lots with profit points had land priced at $0, and citywide comps put South Chicago 3-flats at $468,000 a unit

later.note: add when a licensed tax-delinquency feed is added (V1.2)

location.note: area sales above the city median were dropped: sale prices already drive the profit points, so they counted market strength twice. Comp depth rewards estimates that rest on more local sales. Decision 58, docs/research/decisions-2026-10-30.md

incentives.rule: 2 points per program with a dollar value

label: a sorting aid built from the points shown; it does not rate investment quality
